I believe that the software business will change such that business will no longer need to buy software from another company and can just hire a developer using AI to create bespoke applications as needed by the business. Enterprise applications are oftentimes expensive and don't fit the business's use case exactly. I currently work with applications that can have 20K to 200K licensing costs per year and are just CRUD front ends that a developer working with AI could create in short order and then the business can customize it exactly to what they need and won't have to deal with platform lock-in. When a 100k/yr developer can replace all your software licensing costs with operational costs, the demand for software developers will skyrocket.
